title: A backup for reception check-in
titleZh: 接待櫃檯的備用報到方案

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Our reception display cut out twice. Check-in starts at two today. Can we borrow the training room screen?
turns.zh: 接待處的顯示器中斷過兩次。今天兩點開始報到。能借訓練室的螢幕嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Its stand won’t be back until tomorrow. That screen needs it. Your laptop can show the list by itself.
turns.zh: 它的支架明天才會歸還，那台螢幕少不了它。單用你的筆電也能顯示名單。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: We’ll use that at the counter. The main display always comes back before support arrives.
turns.zh: 我們會在櫃檯用筆電。支援人員到場前，主螢幕總是已恢復。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Note the time if it goes blank again. I can match it to the controller log afterward.
turns.zh: 如果又黑屏，記下時間。我事後可以比對控制器紀錄。
